title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff & regional failover hysteresis
author: Priya Raman
description:
Background: During an incident on 2026-02-26 we observed the SLO enforcer aggressively tripping regional circuit breakers during transient congestion, which caused thrashing between regions and increased tail latency for affected customers. This change is a hotfix to stabilize the enforcer by introducing conservative hysteresis, strengthening quorum checks for failover decisions, and adding backoff smoothing to the backoff/hysteresis state machine.

What I changed (summary): Adjusted default hysteresis window from 10s -> 30s, introduced exponential smoothing on recent error-rate estimates, added a minimum hold time after a failover decision to avoid flip-flopping, and updated quorum logic to require a majority of region controllers to agree before initiating cross-region failover. Also added logging, metrics (slo_enforcer.hysteresis.{enter,exit}, slo_enforcer.quorum_votes), unit tests and an integration test that replays the incident traffic pattern. Updated K8s deployment to apply a default config map with safer defaults and added docs for operational tuning.

Why: The root cause was sensitivity in short windows that made the enforcer react to transient bursts. Increasing hysteresis and smoothing the signals reduces sensitivity while the quorum/hold-time changes avoid system-level oscillation.

Testing: Unit tests for hysteresis/backoff logic (new test suite), integration test that runs against the local canary environment simulating the incident traffic (passes locally and in CI), and manual verification on a staging cluster. Smoke-tested rollback path by toggling feature flag. CI initially revealed a race in the test harness which was fixed in a follow-up commit; full pipeline now green.

Rollback plan: Revert the hotfix commit and redeploy previous config map; operational playbook updated and linked.

Checklist: - [x] Reproduced behavior in test harness - [x] Added unit tests - [x] Added integration replay test - [x] Added metrics and logs for observability - [x] Ran staging verification - [x] Notified oncall and ops - [x] Post-deploy monitoring run for 24h

Notes: This is intentionally conservative — we prefer a slightly higher sustained error-rate to prolonged regional oscillation. We will follow up with longer-term tuning and a config-driven rollout across customers.
